0022600006.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Philadelphia 76ers, who are 1-0 after a road win, sit 1st in the Atlantic, and are 2nd in the East. For Cleveland, Nae'Qwan Tomlin is out with a back issue, while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (hip), and the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 home win on March 9, 2026.
